title: ReLATE: Reliability-Guided Evidence Fusion for Robust UAV--Satellite cross-view Geo-Localization
abstract: arXiv:2607.25524v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV)-satellite cross-view geo-localization matches UAV images against satellite imagery and has achieved impressive accuracy on clean (non-degraded) image benchmarks. In real-world flights, however, UAV observations are frequently affected by adverse weather, illumination changes, platform motion, sensor noise, and compression, while the robustness of existing methods under such degradations remains largely unexamined. In this paper, we present UAVSat-Deg, a large-scale robustness benchmark for degraded UAV-satellite geo-localization, comprising University-1652-Deg and SUES-200-Deg. UAVSat-Deg covers 27 corruption types, including 19 core and 8 compound corruptions, at three severity levels, supports bidirectional drone-to-satellite and satellite-to-drone retrieval as well as multi-height UAV acquisition, and contains more than 11.7 million pre-generated corrupted test images. translated_title: ReLATE：面向鲁棒无人机-卫星跨视角地理定位的可靠性引导证据融合方法
translated_abstract: 无人机（UAV）-卫星跨视角地理定位是将无人机图像与卫星图像进行匹配的技术，在干净（无退化）图像基准上已取得了令人瞩目的精度。然而，在实际飞行中，无人机观测经常受到恶劣天气、光照变化、平台运动、传感器噪声和压缩等因素的影响，而现有方法在这些退化条件下的鲁棒性在很大程度上尚未得到检验。本文提出了UAVSat-Deg，一个面向退化无人机-卫星地理定位的大规模鲁棒性基准，包含University-1652-Deg和SUES-200-Deg两个数据集。UAVSat-Deg涵盖27种损坏类型，包括19种核心损坏和8种复合损坏，并设置三个严重程度级别，支持无人机到卫星和卫星到无人机的双向检索以及多高度无人机采集，包含超过1170万张预生成的退化测试图像。基准测试表明代表性（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 本文提出了ReLATE可靠性引导证据融合方法，并构建了UAVSat-Deg大规模鲁棒性基准，涵盖27种退化类型和超过1170万张退化测试图像，首次系统评估了无人机-卫星跨视角地理定位方法在真实退化条件下的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ReLATE, a reliability-guided evidence fusion method, together with UAVSat-Deg, a large-scale robustness benchmark covering 27 corruption types and over 11.7 million degraded test images, systematically addressing the previously unexamined robustness of UAV-satellite cross-view geo-localization under real-world degradations.
